sources.note: The browser-rendered February 5, 2026 Pilot release confirms a definitive agreement for Extenet's enterprise fiber business only, including former Hudson Fiber Network and Axiom Fiber Network assets; it did not announce an Extenet equity sale.

The browser-rendered August 17, 2026 release states the enterprise fiber acquisition became effective August 15 and covers the former Hudson and Axiom assets, confirming a closed business-line divestiture.

The New York regulatory petition describes an asset purchase by Pilot Fiber NY of specified customer contracts and related network infrastructure. It distinguishes the transferred enterprise assets from Extenet's retained distributed wireless networks.

The rendered current-ownership chart shows Stonepeak Communication Holdings LLC at 42%, KH Killington Communications, LLC at 32% and Other Members collectively at 26%, with no individual Other Member at 20% or more.

The 2020 petition and rendered charts name JH Killington Communications, LLC as the transaction vehicle and show projected post-close ownership of approximately 35% Stonepeak, 30% JH Killington, 19% Digital Bridge and 16% other owners.
The rendered notice of consummation confirms that the JH Killington minority ownership change completed on March 31, 2021.
The rendered 2016 ownership table shows Stonepeak, Digital Bridge, Delta-v, Vertical Towers and management. Northleaf is not named, so this filing cannot establish a direct Northleaf holding.
